title: Hernvann 2020 Supplement B1 taxonomy
supports: Supplement B1 defines 54 groups and exact named members. Generic examples and pooled diets do not imply an exhaustive species list.

title: Hernvann 2020 Supplement B3 landings/discards
supports: Complete 1985 source catches. Allocation uses landings plus Discards.csv; genuine zeros remain distinct from missing values. These are whole-guild composition assumptions.

title: Hernvann 2020 Supplement B4 source biology
supports: Source biomass, PB, QB, EE and BA; printed inputs and completed values distinguished. Accepted scientific values are preserved.

title: Source and accepted computational layers
supports: Canonical source admission is blocked. The accepted routing adapter returns GE and With Egestion FAIL, and TE unsupported. Source and scientific limitations retained.

title: WoRMS exact accepted-name responses
supports: Authoritative exact-label taxonomy and accepted names. Synonyms, distinct species and modern higher-rank limits are distinguished; taxonomy alone does not establish ecological suitability.

title: Additional source-name WoRMS responses
supports: Additional authoritative source-name responses support complete local genus/family candidates.

title: SAU exact reporting keys and FAO ISSCAAP scope
supports: Exact local residual fish keys are bony-fish ISSCAAP39, separate from shark/ray38. Common-name and functional-group reporting limits are checked.

title: FAO Area27 capture taxonomy table p3
supports: Page3 identifies residual marine-fish labels as Osteichthyes39, distinct from sharks/rays38. Reporting taxonomy limits eligible source guilds.

title: Full source-catch candidate allocation ledger

title: Hernvann et al2020 main article
supports: One complete 1985 static baseline; 1985–2016 dynamics and six snapshots are not additional complete static inputs. Figure1 defines the shelf study contour.
